subject: general
question: Which of the following National waterway runs along Coromandal Coast and also through part of Krishna and Godavari river in South India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Waterway-4**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Waterway-4** runs along the Coromandal Coast and passes through parts of the Krishna and Godavari rivers in South India.
 
• It is one of the important waterways facilitating inland navigation and transport in the region.
 
• This waterway enhances connectivity and supports economic activities in the coastal and riverine areas of Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu.
 
• The waterway covers a total length of approximately 1,078 kilometers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Waterways** in India are a series of navigable rivers and canals designated for the purpose of inland water transport.
 
• The Inland Waterways Authority of India (IWAI) is responsible for the development and regulation of these waterways.
 
• National Waterway-4 was declared as a National Waterway in 2008 under the National Waterways Act.
 
• Development of these waterways aims to reduce the burden on road and rail transport and promote eco-friendly and cost-effective transportation.
 
• Other major National Waterways include NW-1 (Ganga-Bhagirathi-Hooghly river system), NW-2 (Brahmaputra river), and NW-3 (West Coast Canal).
 
• Efforts are ongoing to improve the infrastructure and navigability of these waterways to boost trade and commerce.
